intro: The Argent Emissary marks the arrival of two Forsaken representatives of the Argent Dawn tracking Scourge cultists near the Undercity. Their presence underscores both the shared fight against the Scourge and the simmering tension between the neutral order and the Forsaken authorities.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Not sure if you heard, but two emissaries of the Argent Dawn just passed through here. I don't mind the Argent Dawn, but I don't like them poking around Tirisfal unsupervised either. They were both Forsaken... But that doesn't make me any less nervous.

One of them just passed by here, headed southeast. There's a group of scourge cultists snooping around the outskirts of the city in that direction. If those two heard about them, there's no doubt that would have caught their attention.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Stay low and try not to be seen, adventurer. These cultists are not to be trifled with.
